districts.name: Central Plaza
districts.lore: Nine carved stones surround the crystal. Each bears a different craft mark: the city was rebuilt by its people, not by kings.

districts.name: Emberforge District
districts.lore: The oldest anvil is cracked through its maker’s mark. The smith kept it beside the new forge: a reminder that a failed blade can still teach its maker.

districts.name: Wanderer’s Market
districts.lore: The awnings are stitched from the first caravans’ cloaks. A traveler may arrive with nothing; every stall keeps one useful piece within reach.

districts.name: Sanctuary Grove
districts.lore: A ribbon on the shelter beam reads: Leave a little wood for the next fire. The grove has sheltered a hundred journeys and asks no names.

districts.name: Adventurer’s Guild
districts.lore: Some names on the expedition ledger have no return date. Beside each, a guild scribe has left a blank line rather than a final word.

districts.name: Moonbloom Garden
districts.lore: The gardener’s notes say the flowers turn toward riftlight rather than sunlight. One pressed petal marks the page titled: Medicines for the long road.

districts.name: Rift Gate Sanctuary
districts.lore: The watch stones face outward. They were built to welcome returning travelers, not to keep them inside. Four unlit seals await the world guardians.

districts.name: Vanguard Training Grounds
districts.lore: The chalk line is renewed every dawn. This ring is reserved for future duels; today the Vanguard trains against straw, never against another traveler.

districts.name: Hearthside Quarter
districts.lore: A letter waits under a blue stone: I reached the city safely. The forge is loud, the garden is quiet, and there is a light in every window. I think I will stay.
